gen-dafont-dogica-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu reads with wide, tall bowls whose rounds never quite seal, like an unlatched hook. And Dogica stands over it as the heavy one, its wide tracking and open-ended curves giving the pair its most memorable quality.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-anuphan: Anuphan's big round lowercase bowls and open curves with clear gaps give it a friendly, unfussy texture on the page. Dogica makes it feel heavier by comparison.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-arimo: Dogica leads with heavy, commanding letters, lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals and spaced out wide. Arimo, a plain sans, follows with a tall mean line and gaps at its terminals.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-armata: Blocky, wide, and loud. Dogica's heavy lowercase nearly matches its capitals, while Armata's spacious gaps and tall lowercase bodies keep the text beneath it easy on the eye; make the heading generous, and the sans follows comfortably.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-athiti: Dogica's lowercase rises nearly to capital height, and its thickness is low-contrast, heavy and commanding. Athiti keeps one line width throughout, with a high mean line and an s you can see straight through, so a longer passage feels light.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-atkinson-hyperlegib: Heavy, wide-spaced, and blunt. Dogica's lowercase nearly meets its capitals, while Atkinson Hyperlegible's clipped ascenders and wide-set terminals on s stay approachable; shrink the heading and it loses its weight, enlarge the body and it feels bare.

Commanding is how Dogica feels, with wide tracking and lowercase climbing close to the capitals. But Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono lets a longer passage breathe, its open counters and far-stretched spacing leaving plenty of white space between the clipped ascenders.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-blinker: Blinker reads approachably, its lowercase filling most of the height and its apertures wide open. Dogica's heavy, widely tracked letters against that constant-width body make the sharpest difference in the pair.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-carrois-gothic: Carrois Gothic reads modern and professional, with a high-set x-height and a generous opening in c. Carrois Gothic would carry a longer passage smoothly beneath Dogica's wide-tracked, heavy headline.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Dogica's curves each finish with a clear opening, set in wide tracking and heavy, commanding letters. Carrois Gothic SC echoes those openings while keeping capitals and lowercase almost the same height, which is the pair's strongest link.
